name: Readwise
description: Reading highlights, notes, saved articles, newsletters, PDFs, EPUBs, videos, and personal reading knowledge through Readwise and Reader.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Readwise access token, then let agents run bounded library reads or the complete selected Reader and Readwise API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: READWISE_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Readwise access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create the token in your own Readwise account. Railway stores it encrypted and attaches it only to fixed-origin readwise.io requests.

capabilities.label: Read library
capabilities.description: List bounded Reader documents and Readwise highlights.

capabilities.label: Full Readwise API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented Reader and Readwise v2/v3 API authorized by the customer's token.

allowed.label: List highlights
allowed.description: List a bounded Readwise highlight page.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Readwise API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Reader or Readwise v2/v3 operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded library reads run directly; every other operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, token authority, fixed origin, bounds, audits, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Readwise tools and proxies the customer token server-side.
Railway mounts selected Readwise tools and proxies the customer token server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a Readwise access token, enters it in Relay, then selects capabilities and Safe or Dangerous policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Reader documents customer Token authentication plus bounded list, save, update, bulk update, delete, tags, cursor pagination, rate limits, and webhooks.
The original Readwise API documents customer Token authentication and highlight, book, and tag read/write operations.
Readwise's official CLI exposes search/read/create/update/delete across highlights and Reader and explicitly supports headless login with a customer access token.
